The problem

An inbound lead is only useful if someone notices it in time. LeadPulse focused on the handoff between a new enquiry and the agent who needs to respond.

What I built

I built and shipped a B2B SaaS providing automated SMS lead alerts within five minutes, with failover logic. The system was designed around a clear operational action: get the lead in front of an agent.

Beyond the happy path

Shipping included navigating Twilio A2P 10DLC registration and CASL requirements. Messaging infrastructure and the practical conditions for operating it were part of the product work.

What this work demonstrates

A bounded product with a concrete user, a time-sensitive workflow, and delivery concerns beyond the UI. I’m describing the shipped capability here; adoption and conversion results are not yet part of the public case study.
